documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our wholesale distribution team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction is the lack of clarity around their specific requirement or project owner, as stated in their note: 'We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.' This is preventing them from moving forward with a discovery meeting, which is necessary to establish integration requirements.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your wholesale distribution team is currently exploring options, and you're in the process of clarifying your specific requirements. To help move forward, we'd be happy to assist in identifying what you need and how Cedar Systems can support your workflow coordination and account reporting goals. Could you share more about the challenges you're currently facing or the outcomes you're looking to achieve? This will help us tailor our approach to your needs.
questions: What specific challenges is your wholesale distribution team facing that you're looking to address?
Are there any particular goals or outcomes you're aiming to achieve with a new solution?
Have you identified any specific systems or vendors that you'd like to integrate with?
uncertainties: The lack of a defined requirement or project owner may delay the discovery process.
The customer has not provided enough detail to determine the scope of the potential integration.
